name: Bandwidth
description: Bandwidth Programmable Voice v2 calls, conferences, call recording controls, and documented NANP number inventory. French number availability and provisioning are account-dependent and are not exposed by the documented number-search route. Live media uses BXML/WebSocket callbacks.

credential_fields.name: username
credential_fields.label: API User
credential_fields.description: Bandwidth API username used for HTTP Basic authentication.

credential_fields.name: password
credential_fields.label: API Password
credential_fields.description: Bandwidth API password used for HTTP Basic authentication.

credential_fields.name: account_id
credential_fields.label: Account ID
credential_fields.description: Bandwidth account ID used in Voice and Numbers API paths.

credential_fields.name: application_id
credential_fields.label: Voice Application ID
credential_fields.description: Programmable Voice application associated with the outbound From number.

credential_fields.name: phone_number
credential_fields.label: Default From Number
credential_fields.description: Optional owned Bandwidth number in E.164 format.

tools.name: get_account_statistics
tools.description: Read current Programmable Voice call-queue statistics; useful as a credential probe.

tools.name: create_call
tools.description: Queue an outbound Programmable Voice call. answerUrl must return BXML when the call answers; applicationId must belong to the From number. username and password enable Bandwidth Basic authentication for callbacks.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: List recent calls; Bandwidth retains call-state records for seven days.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Read the near-real-time state of a Programmable Voice call.

tools.name: update_call
tools.description: End a call with state=completed, or interrupt it with state=active and a redirectUrl that returns BXML.

tools.name: list_conferences
tools.description: List active and recent Programmable Voice conferences.

tools.name: get_conference
tools.description: Get a conference by its Bandwidth conference ID.

tools.name: update_conference
tools.description: Complete a conference or redirect its BXML execution.

tools.name: get_conference_member
tools.description: Read the mute and hold state of one conference participant.

tools.name: update_conference_member
tools.description: Set hold and/or mute for one conference participant; hold stops that participant hearing or speaking in the conference.

tools.name: update_call_recording
tools.description: Pause or resume the source-side recording of an active call. This does not start a new recording.

tools.name: list_call_recordings
tools.description: List recordings associated with a call.

tools.name: get_call_recording
tools.description: Read metadata and availability for one call recording.

tools.name: search_nanp_available_numbers
tools.description: Search documented North American number inventory by area code, state/city, ZIP, or vanity filter. This route does not document French number searches.
